title: Settlement and Disposal of Consumer Disputes under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.scenario: A consumer complaint is filed against a company for defective goods. The parties reach a settlement, and a settlement report is submitted to the District Commission. The District Commission passes a suitable order recording the settlement and disposes of the matter.
content.outcome: The consumer dispute is settled and disposed of in accordance with the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and the District Commission's order is binding on the parties.

user_queries: How are consumer disputes settled under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019?
What is the role of the District Commission in settling consumer disputes?
Can a settlement be challenged or appealed?
